<tspan x="1019.0" dy="0">Linear / outputs</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="533.5" y="770" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#cdeaf8" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="556.5" y="783" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="556.5" dy="0">Tensor operations</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="616.0" y="811" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="616.0" dy="0">First dimension encodes folded dilation phases in this implementation; selectedN1, not an arbitrary batch claim.</tspan>
<tspan x="616.0" dy="16.52">Filter/gate/residual/skip ModuleList index1 are four independent weight families.</tspan>
<tspan x="616.0" dy="16.52">Two top outputs are loop-state boundaries; the model output head is excluded.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="616.0" y="885" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="616.0" dy="0">Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="616.0" y="915" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="616.0" dy="0">E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="616.0" y="940" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="616.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>
